contract.registry_order_recovery: Selective unregister and re-registration may change listener registry order without corrupting the registry
contract.unique_owner_integrity: Recovery rotations preserve exactly one listener entry per owner
contract.broadcast_order_consistency: Event delivery follows the current listener registry order
contract.delivery_continuity: All registered listeners receive the broadcast exactly once
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.duplicate_idempotency: Duplicate registration does not create duplicate listener entries
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful after registry order changes
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, re-registration, and emit operations require the events permission
